text:
elaine: Heads up—PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4358 failed preview. Linkcheck + md-lint + vale all complaining. Need fast triage before tomorrow's merge window.

sam: Which files?

elaine: /reference/sdk/python.md has an anchor now missing (used to be #init-client, now #client-initialization). Also /guides/migration.md tripped MD013 on a paragraph and /getting-started/setup.md got a Vale warning about 'passive voice'. Preview log snippet: 
```
LinkCheckError: /reference/sdk/python.md: anchor not found: init-client
MD013 line length: /guides/migration.md: line 78
Vale: PassiveVoice -> AvoidPassive at /getting-started/setup.md:20
```

maria: I can do the anchor fix in the SDK doc and run quick preview. Small note: the anchor was renamed in the SDK refactor last week.

sam: I'll take MD013 — will tighten prose, not the code blocks. If code sample is long we'll mark it with a md-lint disable comment.

elaine: Good call. For Vale, what's the minimal change?

maria: Replace "will be handled" with "we handle" or "handles" — one-word swap in most places. I'll push that in the same branch.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #572 failed — errors: 3. Linkcheck: 1 missing anchor. MD013: 2 instances. Vale: PassiveVoice at /getting-started/setup.md:20.

sam: ETA 15m for my MD013 edits. maria: can you open your tiny commit now? If we get three quick commits we can squash.

maria: Pushed commit 2b4c9: fixed anchor, adjusted phrasing in setup.md to active voice. Re-running preview.

docs-bot: New commit on PR 4358 by maria. Triggering preview...

ci-bot: docs-preview build #573 queued.

elaine: Thanks. sam — want me to give you merge permission to force-push a squash, or prefer maintainers squash?

sam: I'm happy to approve + merge once green. No force-push needed if you prefer to let GH squash at merge. Which commit author do we want on the final?

elaine: Ideally single-author = my username for the changelog. Would you be able to squash into a single elaine-authored commit? If not, GH squash with "elaine" as author won't be possible.

sam: I can do a local squash and force-push if you give me push access to the branch. Otherwise we'll rely on GitHub squash and I'll adjust the PR title.

elaine: Granting edit perms now. Go ahead.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #573 succeeded.

sam: OK squashed locally into one commit authored by elaine and force-pushed. PR now has 1 commit.

docs-bot: PR 4358 updated by sam.

elaine: Can someone approve and merge? I need this in before 11:30 PT.

maria: Approved.

sam: Merging now (fast-forward).

docs-bot: PR 4358 merged by sam at 1745010345.

elaine: Amazing, thanks both. If any rendering oddities show up in the site crawl, please ping me and I'll patch in a follow-up. :rocket:
